dateTime.description: The date and time when the engagement event occurred. The timestamp type represents date and time information using ISO 8601 format and is always in UTC time. For example, midnight UTC on Jan 1, 2026 is 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z.

engagementSubType.description: The specific engagement action within the engagement type. The possible values are: like, love, applause, laugh, surprised for reaction; raiseHand for hand; cameraOn, cameraOff for camera; and mute, unmute for microphone.

engagementType.description: The category of the engagement event. The possible values are: reaction, hand, camera, microphone, unknownFutureValue.
